A note about security and privacy

This app supports two login types. Either Tesla account login credentials or a Tesla API token.

To log in with your Tesla access data, a page provided by Tesla will be displayed on which you can enter your access data. This login page generates an “authentication token” and a “refresh token” which the app uses to access the Tesla API.

If you would prefer to provide this token yourself, you can do that too. For example, use the “Auth for Tesla” app, which generates the required token and you just have to insert it into the screen provided in the app. Your token will be retained in the app. Tokens will be revoked if you change your Tesla account password.

At no time is any account information stored on the device or any server.
